Original AI-authored Spanish learning translations and examples, independently
cross-reviewed by model tasks; not human/native-certified or source dictionary
quotations. Released under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0.
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/

Existing 439 dictionary-backed archive entries retain their separate Wiktionary
source links, revisions and notices. The additional 2,971 original teaching
records carry no invented dictionary attribution. See WORDS-LICENSE.md and
src/data/spanish/complete-teaching-review.json for authorship/review scope.
Using a teaching translation as a bundled meaning does not turn it into a
source-provided dictionary definition. No endorsement or accuracy warranty.
